source: Slurm 26.05 (26.05.6-0pre1) built from SchedMD/slurm, slurmctld + slurmdbd (MariaDB) in a fresh container: cluster demo, partitions debug=node[001-002] gpu=node[003-004], Linux users alice bob carol; commands run as root in order, argv exactly as the waldur-site-agent SLURM plugin sends it.

cases.name: sinfo -V
sacctmgr --version
sacctmgr list tres

cpu||1
mem||2
energy||3
node||4
billing||5
fs|disk|6
vmem||7
pages||8
gres|gpu|1001

gres|gpuutil|1003
